title: PR #229: Competitive monitoring report and registry v0.2.5 — 2026-10-25
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose

Daily targeted official-source review for 2026-10-25, compared with expanded registry v0.2.4 from 2026-10-24.

## Changes

- Add versioned delta overlay v0.2.5, expanded registry snapshot v0.2.5, and the dated 2026-10-25 report.
- Add eight product-level baselines: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 pricing; OpenAI Agent Builder and Evals lifecycle; ServiceNow AI Workflow Factory; Microsoft Copilot Home/Code/Autopilot; Samsung Wallet USDC transfers with Solana/Sui partners; and Apple macOS Golden Gate 27.
- Refresh four existing snapshots: Ethereum Hoodi postponement confirmation; MetaMask Agent Wallet source correction (Early Access confirmed, GA still UNVERIFIED); Bubble pricing confirmation; Linux kernel archive confirmation.
- Keep release/publication date, availability date/window and own check date separate. Pricing includes currency, interval, scope, effective date where published, and regional limitations; missing terms remain null/UNVERIFIED.
- Update the validation workflow to resolve v0.2.5 from v0.2.4 and validate the expanded v0.2.5 registry at the exact checked-out SHA.

## Scope and evidence limits

This is a targeted official-source review, not a full market census. The 26 registry entries include 25 product lines with official-source evidence and one Microsoft Agent 365 verification-queue entry that remains UNVERIFIED. ADD means first captured baseline, not a market launch today. The Anthropic Sonnet cache-read reduction was announced effective 2026-10-07, but remains BASELINE because no reliable prior Sonnet product snapshot existed in v0.2.4.

The existing scheduled GitHub workflow validates registry structure, deterministic overlay resolution and tests; it does not crawl vendor sources. No claim is made that source collection is already automated.

## Acceptance

- Draft only; do not merge until the latest exact-head validation run passes and the source claims are reviewed.
- A green validator proves registry/schema checks only, not vendor claims or operational monitoring.
- External runtime dependency remains false as the native implementation target.
